profile.summary: 👋🏽 Hello! My name is Amiyah, and I am an Associate SWE with a passion for Product Management. I am enthusiastic about exploring the intersection of Business, Technology, and Design, and I love working on projects that involve Human-Computer Interaction and AI, which further fuel my passion for programming and product development. Feel free to connect!

volunteerExperiences.description: Generated a collaboration with a local Girls Who Code chapter of high school students. Advertised a volunteering opportunity with my Girls Who Code College Loop of over 200 members.

Led groups of 10 scholars in the grades 2nd to 5th where they learned the foundations of coding in fun ways. Created an environment that kept young students ages 7 to 10 willing and ready to learn. Assisted in assembling lesson plans to administer to students and keep them on track for the school.
